Sets of scenarios, run together

Source: R/compare.R
scenario_set.Rd

scenario_set() collects scenarios to compare; the first is the baseline. run_scenarios() runs them all, the baseline in full and every other incrementally from it, so a plan change that touches a tenth of the sites rebuilds about a tenth of them.

Usage

scenario_set(...)

run_scenarios(x, ..., progress = TRUE)

Arguments

...

For run_scenarios(): passed to estimate_capacity().

x

A scenario set.

progress

Whether to report each run.

Value

scenario_set(): a plancap_scenario_set. run_scenarios(): a plancap_results, a named list of capacity results with the set.

See also

compare_scenarios(), read_scenarios()

Examples

town <- exampleton()
pc1 <- exampleton_pc1()
base <- scenario("Operative", rulebook_example("exampleton"),
                 parcels = town$parcels[town$parcels$parcel_type == "land", ],
                 roads = town$parcels[town$parcels$parcel_type == "road", ],
                 zoning = town$zoning, layers = town[c("height_areas", "flood_hazard", "transit")])
change <- scenario_change(base, "PC1", rulebook = pc1$rulebook, zoning = pc1$zoning)
res <- run_scenarios(scenario_set(base, change))
#> Operative: 4 s.
#> PC1: 3 s, 575 sites copied from the baseline.
res
#> <plancap results> 2 scenarios
#>   scenario sites land_area floor_area residential_floor_area dwellings
#>  Operative 1,379 1,064,000  2,041,525              1,636,652    16,516
#>        PC1 1,379 1,064,000  2,359,511              1,954,638    19,936
